en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hajjal, from Dawood Bin Farqad and Ali Bin Uqba and Sa’alba, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, or one of the two<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The joking removes the water (dignity) of the face, and frequent laughter hurls out the Eman with a hurling’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hajjal from Dawud ibn Farqad and Ali ibn ‘Aqabah and Tha’Labah in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) and abu Ja’far (a.s.) or one of them who has said the following: “
Much joking eliminates the dignity of one’s face and much laughing hurls belief far away.”
